"""Qwen3-8B only - repo-level 3-shot baseline."""
import json
import logging
import random
import time
import torch
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, confusion_matrix
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are a code verification expert. Given a code snippet and a test case, "
    "predict whether the test will pass or fail. Answer with exactly one word: pass or fail."
)
LABEL_MAP = {1: "pass", 0: "fail"}

def load_jsonl(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]

def select_shots(train_data, n_pass=2, n_fail=1, seed=42):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    pass_examples = [ex for ex in train_data if ex["label"] == 1]
    fail_examples = [ex for ex in train_data if ex["label"] == 0]
    rng.shuffle(pass_examples)
    rng.shuffle(fail_examples)
    shots = pass_examples[:n_pass] + fail_examples[:n_fail]
    rng.shuffle(shots)
    return shots

def build_few_shot_user_msg(shots, query):
    parts = []
    for i, shot in enumerate(shots, 1):
        verdict = LABEL_MAP[shot["label"]]
        parts.append(
            f"Example {i}:\n## Code\n{shot['code']}\n\n## Test\n{shot['test']}\n\nVerdict: {verdict}"
        )
    parts.append(
        f"Now predict:\n## Code\n{query['code']}\n\n## Test\n{query['test']}\n\nVerdict:"
    )
    return "\n\n".join(parts)

def detect_thinking_support(tokenizer):
    try:
        tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False,
        )
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}

def parse_prediction(text):
    if "</think>" in text:
        text = text.split("</think>")[-1]
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if text.startswith("pass"):
        return 1
    if text.startswith("fail"):
        return 0
    if "pass" in text and "fail" not in text:
        return 1
    if "fail" in text and "pass" not in text:
        return 0
    return -1

def main():
    import argparse
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--data_dir", default="/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/swebench_full")
    p.add_argument("--qwen_model", default="/home/sonny/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-8B/snapshots/b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218")
    p.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=2)
    p.add_argument("--max_seq_length", type=int, default=8192)
    p.add_argument("--output", default="/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/few_shot_results_repo_level.json")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = p.parse_args()

    train_data = load_jsonl(f"{args.data_dir}/train.jsonl")
    test_data = load_jsonl(f"{args.data_dir}/test.jsonl")
    log.info(f"Train: {len(train_data)}, Test: {len(test_data)}")

    shots = select_shots(train_data, n_pass=2, n_fail=1, seed=args.seed)
    log.info(f"Selected {len(shots)} shots: {[LABEL_MAP[s['label']] for s in shots]}")

    log.info("Loading Qwen3-8B...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.qwen_model, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left")
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    try:
        import flash_attn
        attn_impl = "flash_attention_2"
    except ImportError:
        attn_impl = "sdpa"

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.qwen_model, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, trust_remote_code=True,
        device_map="auto", attn_implementation=attn_impl,
    )
    model.eval()

    tmpl_kw = detect_thinking_support(tokenizer)
    eos_ids = [tokenizer.eos_token_id]
    im_end_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|im_end|>")
    if im_end_id is not None and isinstance(im_end_id, int) and im_end_id != tokenizer.unk_token_id:
        eos_ids.append(im_end_id)

    total = len(test_data)
    y_true, y_pred = [], []
    n_unparseable = 0
    raw_outputs = []

    n_pos = sum(1 for ex in test_data if ex["label"] == 1)
    majority_class = 1 if n_pos >= total - n_pos else 0

    t0 = time.time()
    for i in range(0, total, args.batch_size):
        batch = test_data[i : i + args.batch_size]

        all_ids = []
        for ex in batch:
            user_msg = build_few_shot_user_msg(shots, ex)
            msgs = [
